attributes.name: option selector control style
attributes.definition: How a small set of mutually exclusive options (binary choice, purchase option, language) is presented as a control.

values.definition: Joined segments in a single track/pill with one active segment filled or highlighted.
Individual outlined buttons/chips, each standing alone, with the selected one highlighted.
Options collapsed into a dropdown menu.
Options shown as unstyled text links.
No such selector on the page.

attributes.name: active option highlight treatment
attributes.definition: How the currently selected option is visually distinguished from the others.

values.definition: Selected option has a dark solid fill.
Selected option has a light, soft color fill such as light green.
Selected option is marked as active without a specified fill treatment.
Selection shown by underline, check or bold.

attributes.name: selector placement and labeling
attributes.definition: Whether the selector is centered and carries an explicit heading/label.

values.definition: Control is centered and accompanied by a descriptive heading.
Control sits inline without a heading.
